caption_L1: This is a line graph titled Average viewers of League of Legends on Twitch worldwide from January 2018 to December 2020 (in 1,000s). The x-axis measures Month on linear scale of range 2018 to 2020 while the y-axis plots Number of viewers in thousands using linear scale of range 0 to 200.
caption_L2L3: Viewer numbers show a year on year increase. Viewer numbers tend to peak around July-August, before dropping in October-November, before increasing again in the months leading up to January-Febuary.
